meta.title: Mobile remote view
meta.description: Turns the DSH Web GUI a quarter turn so the sidebar, conversation and right panel each fill a phone screen.

card.note: Stored in the profile: they survive a new port, a restart and another window.
card.note.unavailable: This engine serves no settings transport: changes apply to this page only.
card.note.staleHost: The engine still runs an older host half of this plugin, and a host half loads once per engine process — reloading the window or the desktop app only re-attaches to the same live engine. Restart the engine itself (VS Code: “DeepSeek Harness: 重启 Host”; this page must be reopened) and these values start reaching the profile.
